justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/jsoup/select/Evaluator.java and src/test/java/org/jsoup/select/EvaluatorTest.java. `IsNthLastOfType` is a tiny inner class (lines 680-704) with only a constructor and 2 overridden methods (`calculatePosition` and `getPseudoClass`); it has no fields and no extra responsibilities. The shared `CssNthEvaluator` base class (lines 566-603) holds the generic nth-selector behavior, so this class is just a single-purpose specialization. The tests only exercise its selector semantics and `toString()` (EvaluatorTest.java lines 312-316 and 167-170), which further indicates a cohesive unit rather than an insufficiently modularized class.
